# Frontiers

> Open access publisher of peer-reviewed scientific articles across journals, research topics, news, events, and academic resources.

Frontiers publishes multidisciplinary research through open access journals and provides resources for authors, reviewers, editors, institutions, and funders. The platform also includes article discovery, research topics, science news, events, and information about publishing policies, peer review, and research integrity.

## Core Platform
- [Frontiers homepage](https://www.frontiersin.org): Main entry point for journals, articles, topics, news, and publishing information.
- [Articles](https://www.frontiersin.org/articles): Browse published peer-reviewed research articles across Frontiers journals.
- [Journals](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals): Explore Frontiers journal portfolio by discipline and specialty.
- [Research Topics](https://www.frontiersin.org/research-topics): Discover themed article collections curated by researchers and editors.
- [News](https://www.frontiersin.org/news): Read science news, publisher updates, and research highlights.
- [Events](https://www.frontiersin.org/events): Find webinars, conferences, and academic events hosted or featured by Frontiers.

## Journals and Article Discovery
- [All journals](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals): Directory of Frontiers journals across scientific and scholarly fields.
- [All articles](https://www.frontiersin.org/articles): Search and browse published articles from across the platform.
- [Journal series](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals#journals-a-z): A–Z access to journal titles and specialties.
- [Research Topics](https://www.frontiersin.org/research-topics): Browse special collections organized around emerging research themes.
- [Editors](https://www.frontiersin.org/editors): Explore editorial board participation and editor profiles.
- [Authors](https://www.frontiersin.org/authors): Access author-focused publishing resources and participation pathways.

## Authors
- [For authors](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-authors): Central hub for manuscript submission and author guidance.
- [Submit your manuscript](https://www.frontiersin.org/submission): Start the article submission process on Frontiers.
- [Author guidelines](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-authors/author-guidelines): Requirements and instructions for preparing and submitting manuscripts.
- [Article types](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-authors/article-types): Overview of article formats accepted across Frontiers journals.
- [Publishing fees](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-authors/publishing-fees): Information on article processing charges and payment policies.
- [Open access and licenses](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-authors/open-access): Details on Frontiers open access model and licensing terms.
- [English language editing](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-authors/english-language-editing): Language support options for authors preparing manuscripts.

## Reviewers and Editors
- [For reviewers](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-reviewers): Guidance for reviewers participating in Frontiers peer review.
- [For editors](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-editors): Resources for associate editors and editorial board members.
- [Peer review](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/peer-review): Explanation of Frontiers collaborative peer review process.
- [Review guidelines](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-reviewers/review-guidelines): Practical instructions and expectations for manuscript reviewers.
- [Editor guidelines](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-editors/editor-guidelines): Editorial responsibilities, workflows, and decision-making guidance.
- [Join as editor](https://www.frontiersin.org/careers/editors): Opportunities and information for editorial roles.

## Publishing Policies and Integrity
- [How we publish](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/how-we-publish): Overview of Frontiers publishing model, workflows, and standards.
- [Research integrity](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/research-integrity): Policies and practices supporting publication ethics and quality control.
- [Peer review](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/peer-review): Description of review stages, participants, and editorial oversight.
- [Open access](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/open-access): Frontiers approach to open access publishing and article availability.
- [Copyright statement](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/copyright): Copyright and reuse terms for published content.
- [Publication ethics](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/publication-ethics): Ethical standards for authors, reviewers, and editors.
- [Corrections and retractions](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/corrections-and-retractions): Policies for post-publication updates, corrections, and retractions.

## Institutions and Funders
- [For institutions](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-institutions): Information for universities and organizations working with Frontiers.
- [Open access agreements](https://www.frontiersin.org/open-access-agreements): Institutional and consortia agreements supporting open access publishing.
- [For funders](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-funders): Resources for research funders and publishing support programs.
- [Institutional membership](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-institutions/institutional-membership): Membership options and benefits for participating institutions.
- [Publishing solutions](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-institutions/publishing-solutions): Services and partnership models for institutional publishing support.
- [Impact and reporting](https://www.frontiersin.org/for-institutions/impact): Institutional visibility, reporting, and research dissemination information.

## About Frontiers
- [About](https://www.frontiersin.org/about): Overview of Frontiers as an open access academic publisher.
- [Mission](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/mission): Frontiers mission and goals for open, collaborative science.
- [History](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/history): Background on the founding and development of Frontiers.
- [Leadership](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/leadership): Leadership team and organizational governance information.
- [Careers](https://www.frontiersin.org/careers): Job opportunities across publishing, technology, and editorial functions.
- [Contact](https://www.frontiersin.org/about/contact): Contact information and support channels for Frontiers users.

## News, Blogs, and Events
- [News](https://www.frontiersin.org/news): Publisher announcements, science stories, and research highlights.
- [Blogs](https://www.frontiersin.org/news/blog): Blog posts on publishing, science, and academic community topics.
- [Press office](https://www.frontiersin.org/news/press-office): Media resources and press-related information from Frontiers.
- [Events](https://www.frontiersin.org/events): Upcoming and past academic events, webinars, and conferences.
- [Webinars](https://www.frontiersin.org/events/webinars): Online sessions for researchers, authors, and academic communities.
- [Podcasts](https://www.frontiersin.org/news/podcasts): Audio content featuring science discussions and publishing topics.

## Help and Support
- [Help center](https://help.frontiersin.org): Support portal for authors, reviewers, editors, and readers.
- [Author support](https://help.frontiersin.org/en/support/solutions/folders/6000132593): Help articles for manuscript submission and publishing questions.
- [Reviewer support](https://help.frontiersin.org/en/support/solutions/folders/6000132595): Help resources for reviewers using Frontiers systems.
- [Editor support](https://help.frontiersin.org/en/support/solutions/folders/6000132594): Support documentation for editors and editorial workflows.
- [Policies and procedures](https://help.frontiersin.org/en/support/solutions): Searchable knowledge base for platform procedures and policies.
- [Submit a request](https://help.frontiersin.org/en/support/tickets/new): Contact support for account, submission, or publishing issues.
